description: This file contains utility classes and functions for handling Azure-specific operations within a larger language model client library. It includes custom exceptions, header processing, Azure AD token acquisition through various methods, and methods to initialize and manage Azure SDK clients, primarily for interacting with Azure OpenAI services.

classes.name: AzureOpenAIError
classes.description: Custom exception class for handling errors related to Azure OpenAI communications.

classes.name: BaseAzureLLM
classes.description: A base class extending `BaseOpenAILLM` to facilitate Azure-specific client initialization, token management, and environment validation for Azure OpenAI services.

methods.name: dict process_azure_headers(headers: Union[httpx.Headers, dict])
methods.description: Filters and processes headers from Azure/OpenAI responses to extract rate limit and provider-specific headers.

methods.name: Callable[[],str] get_azure_ad_token_from_entra_id( tenant_id: str, client_id: str, client_secret: str, scope: str = "https://cognitiveservices.azure.com/.default", )
methods.description: Obtains an Azure AD token provider callable using tenant ID, client ID, and client secret via Entra ID.

methods.name: Callable[[],str] get_azure_ad_token_from_username_password( client_id: str, azure_username: str, azure_password: str, scope: str = "https://cognitiveservices.azure.com/.default", )
methods.description: Obtains an Azure AD token provider using username and password credentials.

methods.name: str get_azure_ad_token_from_oidc( azure_ad_token: str, azure_client_id: Optional[str] = None, azure_tenant_id: Optional[str] = None, scope: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Retrieves an Azure AD token access token from an OIDC token.

methods.name: select_azure_base_url_or_endpoint(azure_client_params: dict)
methods.description: Determines whether to use azure_endpoint or base_url for SDK client configuration based on the route.

methods.name: Optional[str] get_azure_ad_token( litellm_params: GenericLiteLLMParams, )
methods.description: Main function to retrieve an Azure AD token using various methods: existing provider, Entra ID, username/password, OIDC, or default credential.
